title: Blog · backend post
description: Server-rendered blog article body using BLOG_POST_CONTENT_SS, enriched with localized metadata, canonical/schema updates, and related posts from Core CMS.

source.adapted_from: Existing BLOG_POST_CONTENT_SS renderer and public blog-post list endpoint.
source.decision: The article body remains server-rendered for crawlability; the shared runtime adds metadata and related navigation without replacing article content.

params.name: Blog · API Base
params.description: Core CMS base path used for the public blog-post endpoint.

params.name: Blog · Organization
params.description: Organization code used in the public Core CMS request.

params.name: Blog · Category ID
params.description: Backend category ID used for related posts. Use 0 to include every category.

params.name: Blog · API Page Size
params.description: Number of backend posts requested per page.

params.name: Blog · Maximum Results
params.description: Safety limit for posts loaded from Core CMS.

params.name: Blog · Index Path
params.description: Public localized route used by the blog index and breadcrumb link.

params.name: Blog · Post Path
params.description: Public localized route prefix used to resolve the current permalink and build related article links.

params.name: Blog · Fixture URL
params.description: Local preview-only JSON URL. Use # in CMS to disable fixture loading.

params.name: Blog Post · Related Limit
params.description: Maximum number of related article cards.

params.name: Blog Post · Blog Link Label
params.description: Link label returning to the blog index.

params.name: Blog Post · Article Fallback Label
params.description: Temporary breadcrumb label before article metadata resolves.

params.name: Blog Post · Related Aria Label
params.description: Accessible label for related article cards.
